Container.Name: Odysseus-ntfy
Container.Overview:
ntfy push-notification server, the notifications companion for Odysseus (reminders, agent/task completion, etc.). Optional.
Set Base URL below to the address your devices will use to reach ntfy (e.g. http://SERVER_IP:8091, or a Tailscale/HTTPS URL), then configure the same URL inside Odysseus's notification settings.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host port for the ntfy server and web app.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Message cache so notifications survive restarts.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: URL your devices use to reach this ntfy server, e.g. http://SERVER_IP:8091.
